# `edva` command-line reference

**Audience:** Edva users and integrators<br>
**Status:** current<br>
**Audited:** `df88a80`<br>
**Evidence:** `selfhost/src/edva.dva:1480-1518`, driver tests

```text
edva <input.dva | module_dir> [options]
```

An input is a source file or a directory module. Normal compilation writes an
executable binary; `-ir` stops after writing LLVM IR. Imports resolve first
relative to the importing source, then from the compiler's `std/` directory. A
file module is preferred over a same-named directory module.

| Option | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `-r`, `--run` | Run the linked binary immediately. |
| `-ir`, `--ir-only` | Emit a `.ll` file without invoking clang. |
| `-c`, `--compile-only` | Compile to an object file (`.o`) or IR without linking. |
| `--module <name>` | Compile as an isolated module unit with `<name>::` prefix. |
| `--entry` | Designate this compilation unit as the executable entry point. |
| `-o <path>` | Set the output binary or object path. |
| `-target <triple>` | Select a target triple (e.g. `x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`, `wasm32-unknown-unknown`). |
| `-O0`, `-O1`, `-O2`, `-O3` | Set code generation optimization level (default `-O2`). |
| `-no-runtime` | Build without the runtime. |
| `-no-prelude` | Do not automatically load `prelude.dva`. |
| `-no-main` | Emit `main` with internal linkage. |
| `-shared` | Build a shared library (`.so`). |
| `-H`, `--header <h>` | Generate a C header from `#export` declarations. |
| `-repl`, `--repl` | Start the stdin-based interactive REPL. |
| `-e <code>` | Parse/evaluate an inline code string. |
| `-ast`, `--ast` | Print the program AST. |
| `-ast-tree` | Print the AST as an indented tree. |
| `-typed-ast`, `-check-types` | Elaborate, verify, and print typed AST statistics. |
| `-typed-ast-tree` | Verify and dump the elaborated typed AST tree. |
| `-h`, `--help` | Show usage. |

`clang` must be available on `PATH` for modes that assemble or link. Use `-ir` when
you only need the generated LLVM IR. In the REPL, `:q` exits the session.
